cohort: 33 pregnant women with cystic fibrosis and 66 matched controls
finding: Multidisciplinary care of pregnancy in women with cystic fibrosis resulted in similar maternal and perinatal outcomes to those found in women in the general population.
mod_finding: Spontaneous labor and vaginal deliveries were less frequent in women with CF than in controls, but there was no difference in caesarean section rates.
gest_age: 38.1 ± 1.6 weeks in CF group, 38.4 ± 1.1 weeks in control group
birth_weight: 3042 ± 91 g in CF group, 3119 ± 92 g in control group
